changelog: **A mentorship has a lifecycle state, and `status` is derived from it (#1768):** `MentorshipRelation.lifecycleState` (a free String, nullable with a DB default of `ACTIVE` — expand → backfill → contract) now carries every state — `ACTIVE`, `PAUSED`, `COMPLETED` and the existing `ENDED_REMATCHED` / `ENDED_REASSIGNED` / `ENDED_CHURNED` — plus a `pausedAt` stamp. `src/lib/relationLifecycle.ts` holds the legal moves (`canTransition`: ACTIVE ⇄ PAUSED, live → terminal, terminal → ACTIVE only), the one derivation `statusForLifecycle()` (ACTIVE/PAUSED → `status = ACTIVE`), `effectiveLifecycleState()` (reads a pre-backfill or legacy row truthfully) and `billableRelationWhere()`. `BILLABLE_RELATION_STATES` now applies to the lifecycle state, so a paused pair is off the invoice and off the plan-gate count through the same one allowlist. `prisma/backfill-relation-lifecycle.mjs` (idempotent, on deploy) fills the column from `status`; the legacy PUT and migration writers keep the two columns agreeing. `enum MentorshipStatus` is untouched and no `status: 'ACTIVE'` reader changes behaviour. No UI yet — pausing arrives with #1770.
